reuse.why: Extends the existing assertCanLinkBankAccount guard that every provider link already calls, and extracts the unlink-account field reset into clearBankLink so unlinkAccount and the takeover share it.

duplication.why: The unlink field reset is moved into one helper instead of being copied, and the flag is threaded through the one shared guard.

placement.why: All changes sit in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers and unlinkAccount, using the shared LinkAccountBaseParams type.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard, the extracted helper and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; the guard now has side effects (unlinks holders before the link is created) and each of six link functions still forwards the flag by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every link handler goes through prepareBankAccountForLink; unlinkAccount uses clearBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the reset was extracted rather than copied.
